en.headline: Security guard survives fall from To Kwa Wan rooftop after canopy breaks descent
en.dek: A man remained conscious after falling from the rooftop of Tak Shing Mansion early Friday while inspecting a burst pipe, landing on a third-floor podium.
body: Police are investigating after a security guard fell from height at a building in To Kwa Wan early on Friday and survived after a canopy broke his fall.

According to reports, at around 5am a passer-by reported that a man had fallen from Tak Shing Mansion at 50 Tam Kung Road and landed on the third-floor podium. The man was still conscious when rescuers arrived and was taken to hospital.

Sources indicated the building is a high-rise and that a water pipe had burst on the exterior of the 13th floor. The male security guard was reportedly on the rooftop inspecting the burst pipe when he accidentally fell. During the descent he struck the pipe, causing water to spray out, before the canopy stopped his fall.
Police are looking into the man's identity and the circumstances of the incident.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣保安從天台墮下 雨篷緩衝後仍有意識送院
zh.dek: 一名保安清晨在德成大廈天台視察爆裂水管時意外墮下，跌至三樓平台，雨篷緩衝其墮落，仍有意識。
body: 警方正調查一宗土瓜灣墮樓事件，一名保安於周五清晨從大廈墮下，幸獲雨篷緩衝後仍有意識並送院。
據報，約凌晨5時，一名途人報稱有人從譚公道50號德成大廈墮下，跌至三樓平台。救援人員到場時男子仍有意識，並將他送往醫院。
消息指該大廈為高樓，外牆13樓有水管爆裂。男保安據報在天台視察爆管時意外失足墮下，過程中撞到水管導致噴水，其後由雨篷緩衝其墮落。
警方正調查男子身份及事件原因。
